sections.heading: 20+ Years of European Expertise
sections.leadText: Eurotech Auto Repair Centre has been one of Auckland's leading panel and paint workshops — specialising exclusively in European vehicles.
paragraphs: Based in Mt Wellington, we combine factory-authorised repair methods with the latest equipment and technology to deliver results that meet manufacturer specifications every time.

sections.heading: Factory Authorisations
paragraphs: We hold certifications that set us apart from general body shops:

items: NZ's only factory-authorised Jaguar/Land Rover structural repairer — certified for aluminium structural repairs
NZ's only accredited BMW Carbon Fibre Body Shop

image.alt: Technician working on Range Rover in aluminium repair bay

sections.heading: Our Expert Staff
paragraphs: Our technicians are factory-trained specialists, not generalists. The team includes I-CAR certified welders and technicians who have completed Jaguar aluminium structural repair courses — training only available to authorised repairers.
Our refinish staff are trained in Glasurit automotive paint systems, the same premium products used by manufacturers. This ensures colour accuracy and a finish indistinguishable from factory.

image.alt: Spray painter applying paint in booth

sections.heading: Why It Matters
paragraphs: Modern European vehicles use advanced materials — high-strength steel, aluminium, carbon fibre — bonded and riveted in ways that require specific knowledge and equipment to repair safely.

A repair done to the wrong specification can compromise structural integrity, void the warranty, and reduce the vehicle's value. That's why factory authorisation exists, and why choosing the right repairer matters.
Every repair we carry out follows manufacturer specifications, meets insurer requirements, and carries a written guarantee.
